retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait focusing on the back of a head featuring intricate lettering sculpted directly into the hair texture.
excludeWhen: traditional typography on a flat background

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up black and white photograph of the back of a person's head. The subject has short, wavy, light-colored hair with a horizontal band shaved into the middle to reveal darker, textured lettering formed by the remaining hair. The neck features faded tattoos and a thin silver chain.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured hair waves at the top contrasting with the sharp shaved band
Dark hair-sculpted letters against a pale, shaved scalp background
Symmetrical composition framed by the ears
Organic neck tattoos grounding the geometric hair design

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, sculpted lettering in the center of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the wavy hair on top, moves down to the sharp lettering, then follows the neck tattoos to the chain.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean, light gray neutral background surrounding the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the hair texture
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the lettering and tattoos
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white highlights in the hair waves
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between shaved skin and dark hair.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are formed by leaving patches of hair while shaving the surrounding area
Vertical strokes are thick and textured
The baseline and x-height are constrained within a straight horizontal band
characterSpecificRedesigns: Glyphs must appear three-dimensional due to hair depth
Edges are slightly soft due to hair follicles

anatomy.xHeight: Full height of the shaved band

composition.warp: Conforms to the curvature of the head
composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the subject's physical form

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, pointed terminals and heavy weight of the hair art.
Aligns with the urban tattoo aesthetic present on the neck.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail monochrome photo of the back of a head with light-colored wavy hair and a horizontal band shaved across the middle. Include neck tattoos and a silver chain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a custom brush that mimics hair texture, paint gothic-style lettering into the shaved band, ensuring the letters look like they are made of short, dark hair growing from the scalp.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like it is made of hair?
Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the composition centered on the back of the head?
Are the ears visible on the sides?

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the lettering area

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the text follows the curve of the skull
Check that the shaved band has a realistic 'stubble' texture
Ensure the lighting highlights the waves in the top hair
Verify the neck tattoos look faded and integrated into the skin
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome back-of-head portrait + [hair texture type] + [shaved band] + [sculpted hair lettering style] + [neck accessories/tattoos]
